title: Fix Admin Access & Add Media Upload to Community Posts

requirements.text: Fix the admin bootstrap logic so that the very first user to register/create a profile is automatically assigned the Admin role. If no admin exists yet when a new user profile is created, that user should be promoted to Admin without requiring any manual token claim.

quotes: پہلا registered user automatically Admin بنے

acceptanceCriteria: When the very first user profile is created, the backend assigns them the Admin role automatically.
Subsequent users are NOT automatically made Admin.
The admin panel is accessible to the first registered user without any additional steps.
If an admin already exists, new users are created as regular users.

requirements.text: Update the backend CommunityPost data type and related functions to support optional image, video, and file attachments stored as blobs. Each post should support: a text/caption field (already present), an optional image blob field, an optional video blob field, and an optional file attachment blob with its filename.

quotes: Community میں Photo/Image add کرنے کا option
Video/File upload بھی support ہوگا community posts میں

acceptanceCriteria: CommunityPost type includes optional fields for image blob, video blob, and file attachment blob plus filename.
Backend exposes updated createCommunityPost function accepting these optional media fields.
Existing posts without media continue to display correctly.
Media blobs are stored and retrievable via the backend actor.

requirements.text: Update the Community page post submission form to allow users to attach an image (JPG/PNG/GIF), a video (MP4/WebM), or a file, alongside their text/caption. Show a preview of the selected image before posting. Display a caption/text input field alongside the media picker. On submit, send the media blob(s) together with the post text to the backend.

quotes: photo کے ساتھ text/caption بھی لکھ سکیں گے

acceptanceCriteria: Community post form has a media attachment button with options for image, video, or file upload.
After selecting an image, a preview thumbnail is shown before submission.
Text/caption field is present and required alongside any media.
Submitted posts containing images display the image inline in the community feed.
Submitted posts containing videos display a playable video player in the feed.
Submitted posts containing files display a downloadable file link in the feed.
File type and size validation provides user-friendly error messages for unsupported types.

constraints: Do not change the existing community post approval workflow.
All blob/media storage must remain within the Motoko backend actor — no external storage services.
Immutable frontend paths (hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, hooks/useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui) must not be modified.
nonGoals: Real-time media streaming or live video features.
External CDN or cloud storage for media files.
Adding media upload support to any page other than Community posts.
Changing the existing admin panel UI or its feature tabs.
